authorization: 先统一校准各组 Critic 的拟合，再开展在线 PPO 对照。
stage: 4 calibration supplement; deliver for acceptance before stage5
pilot_split: training instances solver0 fit, solver1 inner validation; development never selected on
selection: per loss smallest instance-equal inner-validation raw MSE; ties prefer fewer updates then smaller lr
final_update_rule: one selected fixed final count for all groups/seeds within each loss; no development best-of
mse_calibration: train-only instance-equal static target normalization, inverse raw-value decoding; final linear zero weights/bias
hl_gauss_calibration: fixed raw bins [-36,52]/64, sigma 0.75 bin; final weights zero, bias log of train-only instance-equal smoothed target marginal; floor 1e-6
architecture: original TreeGate structure unchanged; no extra parameters for calibration; frozen encoder unchanged
gpu_scope: existing offline cached tensor fitting only
quality_gate: main MSE groups each mean train MSE <=0.8 of train-mean constant; all seed/group train MSE below constant; heldout error/seed stability separately reported
research_scope: exploratory reuse of previously inspected development set; neither paper-scale reproduction nor online gains
